programs.note: Department of Education state funds (Schedule 9) spread over ages 4-18 by population; includes transitional kindergarten and state preschool. The local property-tax share of school funding is local money and is not here
University of California, California State University and Student Aid Commission state funds (Schedule 9) spread over ages 18-29 by population; no enrolment by age was used
Community colleges state funds (Schedule 9, including bond-funded construction) spread over ages 18-39 by population; no enrolment by age was used

programs.program: Medi-Cal and other state health care (state share)
programs.note: Department of Health Care Services state funds (Schedule 9; almost all Medi-Cal, and including provider fees and drug rebates the budget counts as special funds), split in three steps: California's Medicaid spending by eligibility group (MACPAC, federal fiscal year 2023: children, expansion adults, other adults, disabled, aged); the share the state pays for each (assumed 10% for expansion adults and 50% for the rest); then age (children at 0-18, adults by Medi-Cal eligibles aged 19-44 and 45-64, disabled people by SSI recipients' ages, aged people between 65-84 and 85 and over by CMS's national shape)

Department of Developmental Services state funds (Schedule 9) split like regional-center spending for ages 0-2, 3-21 and 22 and over (DDS annual purchase-of-service report, 2023-24), then within each like the people served by finer age group
State funds for IHSS (Department of Social Services budget page) spread like recipients in six age groups (January 2024), assuming equal hours per person
State funds for SSI/SSP spread like California's SSI recipients under 18, 18-64 and 65 and over (SSA, December 2025), within each by population
State funds for CalWORKs spread by children and adults in cash-grant cases (2023-24), assuming equal dollars per person; children over ages 0-17 and adults over 18-49 by population
State funds for subsidised child care (Department of Social Services) spread over ages 0-12 by population

not_allocated.name: Prisons and rehabilitation
not_allocated.reason: Ages of people in prison exist, but they are not recipients in this page's sense

not_allocated.name: Retirement contributions (teachers, state retirees' health, CalPERS)
not_allocated.reason: Pay for past work, not a benefit by age

not_allocated.name: School reserve withdrawal (Public School System Stabilization Account)
not_allocated.reason: Paid to K-12 schools and community colleges, but the split between them is not in these files; counting it would raise the youngest brackets

not_allocated.name: Realignment money passed to counties
not_allocated.reason: State special funds that counties spend on health, mental health and social services, including county shares of in-home care and CalWORKs; no age split found

not_allocated.name: Shared revenues sent to local governments
not_allocated.reason: Spent by cities and counties, not by the state

not_allocated.name: Rest of education
not_allocated.reason: Bond debt service, school facilities, the state library and other colleges and commissions: no age split used

not_allocated.name: Rest of the Department of Social Services
not_allocated.reason: Child welfare, county administration and other assistance: no age split found

not_allocated.name: Rest of health and human services
not_allocated.reason: Public health, state hospitals and other departments: no age split found

not_allocated.name: Everything else
not_allocated.reason: Transportation, courts, natural resources and general government (mostly collective costs), plus housing, employment and veterans programs with no age split
